pipeline_params.routing_input: prompt text only: a TF-IDF + logistic-regression task classifier trained on our own practice prompts predicts the task type
pipeline_params.policy: per-task model pick fitted on our own practice data (5-fold CV, lambda 0.02); where the pick is gemini-3-flash-preview, Qwen3-235B and Gemma-4-31B answer first; Gemini is called when their final answers disagree, or when they agree but a self-hosted answer critic (fine-tuned on our own practice data; it reads only the prompt and our models' answers) scores the shared answer below 0.5
pipeline_params.cost_accounting: every call is charged on the returned row: other calls' dollar cost is added as returned-model input-price tokens; see generated_result.cascade_accounting
